comparison.objective: Tune and lock a robot-axis damper vs mount and tighten a DIN-rail end bracket.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key setscrew engagement, collar tuning, and counterholding vs bracket hooking/seating, rail stabilization, screwdriver alignment, and clamping.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe impact cycles plus witness-test retention vs bracket seating/flushness, 0.5 Nm tightening, and rail-motion limits.
comparison.reason: Both include bimanual stabilization and tool tightening, but one tests dynamic-response commissioning while the other tests component installation and geometric seating.
